sections.title: Research Interests
sections.body: My research interests center on psychological mechanisms underlying behavior change, particularly how motivational processes from a self-determination perspective and self-regulatory processes (e.g., metacognitive regulation) jointly translate intention into sustained physical activity across the lifespan. I am also interested in translating these mechanisms into scalable, theory-informed digital support that integrates ecological momentary assessment and intervention.
